source.segmentation: Split sanitized printed text at blank lines; B01-B43 are paragraphs, not PDF pages or independently verified clauses.

instructions: Return exactly one item for every supplied block ID. Use only the supplied IDs, not generated source quotes.
Assign all observable printed-content families; several labels may apply to one block. OTHER may coexist when a material part is not covered by the named families.
Use EXCLUDED alone for the technical signature marker. Do not infer handwriting, completed fields, appendix contents, identity, delivery, payment or realization from printed promises.
Do not decide legal validity, material risk, actual performance or which conflicting time or instrument is correct. Preserve empty fields and conflicting printed terms for later review.

second_pass_dependencies.issue: Printed duration versus dates and option conditions must be read together; payment-check count cannot repair the term.
Rent-payment checks and the named security check are separate instruments; a bank-guarantee return phrase does not prove a second issued instrument.
A general occupancy restriction and the special agreed-occupant clause need joint reading.
Early departure payments and post-term holdover compensation have different triggers.
Repair allocation, conditional reimbursement/set-off and condition acknowledgment remain separate; Appendix B content is unavailable.
Breach threshold, interest, termination and postal-delivery timing are distinct events.

limitations.purpose: A development smoke trace and output contract for a later provider-neutral first-pass test, not evidence that a new model detects these entities.
